macros.name: nlastref

macros.name: nparentref

macros.name: Nref

macros.name: propfootnotechoice
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨inside⟩ within the text of a footnote, and to ⟨outside⟩ anywhere else.

macros.name: propformlabel
macros.doc: Expands to the formatted label of the (approximately) items-th item in this environment, computed at \begin{prop} before the list dimensions are applied, so it can be used directly in dimension expressions.

macros.name: proprepeat
macros.doc: Prints ⟨token⟩ as many times as the value of ⟨counter⟩.

macros.name: propwidestlabel
macros.doc: The same as \propformlabel, but with every digit replaced by the digit that makes the label widest (an 8 in many fonts).

macros.name: Ref
macros.doc: Titlecase variants of \ref and \ref*: uppercases the first letter of the formatted output.
